source.note: Fase 4b TakeoffDetector tuning, not AFM/AIC data. Every default here is derived from 9 real recorded take-off rolls (docs/data/reallife-samples/, see that directory's README.md for the full write-up) - margins are chosen with real headroom below/above the observed values, not tuned to the midpoint of a handful of examples. Always user-adjustable, never hardcoded in Kotlin (rekenlogica.md section 9).

turn_bearing_swing_deg_note: Cumulative bearing swing (degrees) that qualifies a ground turn as the taxi-to-runway turn preceding the roll. Real turns swung 64-96 deg; taxi-roll bearing stayed flat within ~2-4 deg.
turn_window_seconds_note: Maximum time window a candidate turn is allowed to accumulate its bearing swing over.
turn_max_speed_mps_note: Speed ceiling (m/s) below which a bearing change can count toward a ground turn - excludes airborne/fast-taxi bearing changes.
min_sustained_accel_mps2_note: Plausibility FLOOR only, never a ceiling, for the roll's sustained acceleration. Observed real rolls: 1.4-3.3 m/s^2, but that is 4 examples and aerotow (slower acceleration) has no real recording yet.
roll_sustain_window_samples_note: Consecutive qualifying samples an acceleration run must sustain before it counts as the roll itself, not a brief pre-roll throttle blip.
min_roll_end_speed_mps_note: Minimum speed (m/s) the acceleration run must reach - excludes 'lineup and wait' throttle blips that never reach real rolling speed.
baro_bucket_seconds_note: Bucket width (seconds) barometer/altitude samples are averaged into before slope/height checks - raw barometer samples run ~25Hz and are too noisy to use directly.
baro_baseline_window_seconds_note: How many seconds before roll-start are averaged to establish the ground-reference pressure (P0).
lift_off_dp_dt_threshold_hpa_per_s_note: Margin below the observed ~0.4-0.5 hPa/s onset slope at real lift-off - the pressure rate-of-change that marks the start of a sustained climb.
lift_off_sustain_buckets_note: Consecutive buckets the climb rate must stay above threshold before lift-off is confirmed, not a single noisy bucket.
fifteen_m_height_m_note: Height AGL (meters) that marks the AFM's 'over 15m obstakel' figure - the standard 50ft obstacle height.
height_crossing_hysteresis_buckets_note: Consecutive buckets height must stay above the 15m threshold before the crossing is confirmed - avoids single-bucket noise chattering across the boundary.
